children: The predict.fun market for the LCK playoff matchup between T1 and BFX shows a 93% probability of T1 defeating BFX. According to Odaily, the LCK playoffs began this afternoon with T1 facing BFX in a best-of-five series, and the first game is now underway.

T1, as the higher-ranked regular-season team, had the choice of opponent among KT and BFX and selected BFX. DK will face KT tomorrow. The playoffs use a double-elimination format, so the loser of this match will move into the lower bracket.

BFX secured its playoff berth only yesterday after advancing through the play-in stage. The team first eliminated NS 3-1, then came from behind against BRO in the final round after trailing 1-2, winning the last two games to advance 3-2.

title: T1 Favored at 93% in LCK Playoff Matchup Against BFX
